rules: learning.rs validate_practice_question excludes retired and multistep records and invalid checkbox questions; captured records have ordinary gradable blank/radio fields and no retirement flag.
learning.rs lesson candidate filter excludes seen records.
question_selection.rs selects a positive rated difficulty band first, then a uniform index from sorted entity IDs; unknown difficulties are fallback only.
Without configured policy weights, select returns the first sorted candidate; no shape-based guarantee is inferred for that legacy configuration.
prospective_batch: All 5 accepted generated records are easy; each has the same conditional weight within the easy pool. No shape/label/template filter. Database entity IDs do not yet exist, so future exact draw sequence is not asserted.
limits: No captured learner history or policy weights: conclusions condition on a positive easy weight and fresh records. Seen records are removed, so later learner-specific finite subsets need not remain balanced.
Captured basis 5665 only; no database access.
